# Generated by the ZIN content builder (modules/world_tension.mjs, docs/specs/03_gameplay/05_world_tension_and_endings.md). Do not edit by hand.
# on_startup: the Gathering Dark, its rate, the first world tick and the path's start check. on_annex: an annexed runner hands the tick to its annexer.
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			set_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark = constant:zin_world.start }
			if = {
				limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_gathering_dark option = SLOW } }
				set_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark_rate = constant:zin_world.rate_slow }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_gathering_dark option = FAST } }
				set_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark_rate = constant:zin_world.rate_fast }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark_rate = constant:zin_world.rate_normal }
			}
			zin_world_schedule_tick = yes
			if = {
				limit = { has_event_target = zin_world_runner }
				event_target:zin_world_runner = { country_event = { id = zin_path.1 days = 1 } }
			}
		}
	}
	on_annex = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { FROM = { has_country_flag = zin_world_runner } }
				FROM = { clr_country_flag = zin_world_runner }
				ROOT = {
					set_country_flag = zin_world_runner
					save_global_event_target_as = zin_world_runner
					country_event = { id = zin_world.2 days = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
